name: Hansabanka Contemporary Art Collection

scope.definition: All works documented in the 2007 Hansabanka Contemporary Art Collection catalogue. 386 works by 108 Latvian artists, as listed on catalogue pages 222–229.
scope.source: Žeivaite, Ilze, et al. Hansabankas mūsdienu mākslas kolekcija / Hansabanka Contemporary Art Collection. Rīga: Hansabanka, 2007. (SRC-HANSABANKA-2007, Wikidata Q139986317)

listing.description: 386 works by 108 Latvian artists collected by Hansabanka between 1998 and 2007, documenting a decade of contemporary Latvian art. Now held by Swedbank Latvia.

_notes: Spec 15 Part C3 slice. 18 works originally catalogued 2026-06-24 under AA/LV/HANS/001-018; on 2026-07-05, 17 were found to duplicate thinner stub records already published under AP-2026-000203-000335 (2026-07-02 bulk batch) — the richer AA/LV/HANS documentation (provenance, artist authority links, structured data) was merged into those live AP-2026 records, which are now canonical. The 18th (HANS/009, Autumn by Herberts Siliņš) had no stub counterpart and was published as new record AP-2026-000336. AA/LV/HANS/001-018 are superseded and retained only as data-layer history.
